name: run-tests

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - '**.php'
      - '.github/workflows/run-tests.yml'
      - 'phpunit.xml.dist'
      - 'composer.json'
      - 'composer.lock'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'yarn.lock'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  javascript-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: yarn

      - name: Validate lockfile and dependency integrity
        run: yarn install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.5', '8.6']
        laravel: ['13.*']
        stability: [prefer-lowest, prefer-stable]
        include:
          - laravel: 13.*
            testbench: ^11.1

    name: P${{ matrix.php }} - L${{ matrix.laravel }} - ${{ matrix.stability }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Install rsync
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rsync

      - name: Configure SSH for test containers
        run: |
          chmod 600 tests/docker/keys/laravel_backup_server_id_rsa
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          printf 'Host 0.0.0.0\n  StrictHostKeyChecking no\n  UserKnownHostsFile /dev/null\n' >> ~/.ssh/config

      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php }}
          extensions: dom, curl, libxml, mbstring, zip, pcntl, pdo, sqlite, pdo_sqlite, bcmath, soap, intl, gd, exif, iconv, imagick
          coverage: none

      - name: Setup problem matchers
        run: |
          echo "::add-matcher::${{ runner.tool_cache }}/php.json"
          echo "::add-matcher::${{ runner.tool_cache }}/phpunit.json"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          composer require "laravel/framework:${{ matrix.laravel }}" "orchestra/testbench:${{ matrix.testbench }}" --no-interaction --no-update
          composer update --${{ matrix.stability }} --prefer-dist --no-interaction

      - name: Execute tests
        run: ./vendor/bin/pest --compact

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
